Name: Baaseiah, Son of Malchiah
Summary: Son of Malchiah and father of Michael in Asaph's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:40: Son of Malchiah and father of Michael in Asaph's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Baaseiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
